messages.subject: Hosting files in shiny app
parts: Is it possible to host files in a shiny app that can then be opened when linked to in a shiny app. For instance, could I store reports in HTML format in my project directory. Using leaflet i can display the points the files are associated with. What i would then like to do is link to an HTML report in a marker popup and open the report from the shiny leaflet map. Is this possible??
